title: Terms and Conditions
seoDescription: Terms of use and booking conditions for Golden Bay Holiday Homes.

sections.heading: Marketplace operator
sections.body: Golden Bay Holiday Homes facilitates stays in properties we manage. We act as a marketplace operator for GST purposes where applicable under New Zealand law.

sections.heading: Bookings
sections.body: A booking is confirmed when you receive written confirmation and any required deposit or payment has been processed. House rules for each property form part of your agreement.

sections.heading: Guest responsibilities
sections.body: Guests must respect occupancy limits, pets policies, quiet hours, and leave the property in a reasonable condition. Excess cleaning or damage may be charged.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount paid for the relevant booking. Nothing in these terms limits rights under the Consumer Guarantees Act.

sections.heading: Website use
sections.body: Content on this site is for general information. Property details may change; confirm specifics on your booking confirmation.
